_comment_path: The interpreter path uses BACKSLASHES. cmd.exe parses a leading .venv/Scripts/... as the command `.venv` with a /Scripts switch, so the forward-slash form declared on 2026-08-15 exited in 0s with `'.venv' is not recognized` and the gate never ran once from the hook.
_comment_budget: The harness clamps timeoutSec to 170s. The unit suite is ~2276 tests in 480-560s on this 4 GB box, so it CANNOT be the hook gate: declaring it there gets the hook killed and produces no report at all, which is worse than a smaller gate. fast is therefore a smoke gate and says so; full is the definition of done and is run DETACHED (Start-Process -RedirectStandardOutput), never from the hook.
full: cd apps/api && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/unit -q && cd ../admin && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run check:no-dusk-tokens && npm run check:ops-room-wiring && npm run test:unit && cd ../widget && npm run build && node scripts/check-size.mjs
